_comment: Public example cases so the harness runs for anyone, including CI. Real investigations belong in a private file pointed at by SUI_CASES_FILE — the addresses in a live case should not be committed. Same arrangement SUI_LABELS_FILE uses for attribution.

cases.name: obfuscated-wrapper-into-deepbook
cases._why: This transaction calls two packages with hashed module names and emits twelve DeepBook events. Protocol identification from events, and decoded event fields, both regressed here before — the response once read `protocols: []` while the events named DeepBook outright.

cases.name: batch-funded-wallet
cases._why: A wallet first funded by a twenty-way uniform payout. Exercises funding attribution, the batch-payout weighting, and cluster membership on a public address.
